summary: Backend: 20/20 pytest cases passed (auth, students CRUD, filtering, role protection, courses, proofs upload via Emergent storage, admin stats/late, messages flow, invalid token). Frontend: admin login works, students list screen renders with 4 seeded students + cohort/status filter chips, Relancer sur WhatsApp button visible, 'En retard' tab filters to late students. Student login flow partially reached (navigation confirmed via admin flow). Core flows validated end-to-end.

issues: Ionicons font load returns 502 from Expo asset endpoint; icons fall back to boxes/empty circles. Likely CDN-side; app still usable but visual polish affected.

action_items: Investigate Ionicons font 502 (Metro asset loading) - possibly add @expo/vector-icons font preloading via useFonts or ensure the asset URL is reachable
Add testID attributes to login button, tabs (Étudiants/En retard/Bilan/Compte), filter chips, course cards and welcome modal to make UI tests more robust
Admin stats and Compte/Déconnexion were not reached by selector 'Stats'/'Déconnexion' in the time budget; main agent can self-verify via UI since backend /api/admin/stats passes
critical_code_review_comments: server.py recomputes stats for every student on every list call (N recompute writes per request); acceptable for demo scale but should be batched or lazy for production
proof-url endpoint returns a relative URL ('/api/files/...'); frontend must prefix with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL - verify in UI image rendering
/api/admin/id is unauthenticated; low risk (returns only id+name) but should require auth

context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints green. Use pytest /app/backend/tests/test_jzk_backend.py for regression. Frontend admin tabs confirmed; student dashboard/courses/messages not fully walked due to Ionicons font 502 slowing navigation.
